title: Canonical shifted truncation cohomology comparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category] with t-structures $t_{\mathcal C},t_{\mathcal D}$ [def-weil-t-structure]. Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an exact functor with specified coherent shift comparisons $\sigma^r_{F,N}:F(N[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}(FN)[r]$, preserving both halves in every integer degree. Write $c^-_{F,r}:F\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\le r}\xrightarrow{\sim}\tau_{\mathcal D}^{\le r}F$ and $c^+_{F,r}:F\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\ge r}\xrightarrow{\sim}\tau_{\mathcal D}^{\ge r}F$ for the canonical comparisons normalized by the counit and unit equations of [lem-pod-texact-truncation-comparison]; their construction uses the truncation adjunctions and does not require boundedness. For $r\in\mathbf Z$ put $H_{\mathcal C}^r=(\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\ge r}\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\le r})[r]$ and define $H_{\mathcal D}^r$ similarly. The canonical natural isomorphism $h_F^r:FH_{\mathcal C}^r\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{\mathcal D}^rF$ is the composite whose component at $K\in\mathcal C$, with $N=\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\ge r}\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\le r}K$, is
$$h^r_{F,K}=\bigl(\tau_{\mathcal D}^{\ge r}(c^-_{F,r,K})\circ c^+_{F,r,\tau_{\mathcal C}^{\le r}K}\bigr)[r]\circ\sigma^r_{F,N}.$$
Associators identify the functor parenthesizations. This definition specifies the composite itself, with no arbitrary choice of comparison.
